column3: The Hebrew connects the clauses with and rather than because.
The Hebrew does not explicitly qualify the songs as wedding songs.
The Hebrew says the widows did not weep rather than could not lament.
The Hebrew describes the warrior shouting from wine rather than being overcome by it.
The Hebrew says did not choose rather than refused.
The Hebrew specifies nursing ewes and being behind them.
The Hebrew does not repeat David's name and describes the understanding of his hands.
